spans.s:
f. (-णिः or -णी)
The earth.
E.
क्षोणि the earth, and अण् pleonastic, with इन् or ङीप् fem. terminations added.

m. (-रः)
The ocean.
E.
क्षौणी the earth, and प्राचीर an enclosure.

Water.
m. (-द्रः)
A flower, (Michelia champaca.)
E.
क्षुद्रा a fly, &c. affix अञ्.

mfn. (-क्यः-की-क्यं)
Small, minute.
E.
क्षुद्र Small, ञ्यट् pleonastic aff.

mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
Linen, made of linen, covered with it, &c.
f. (-मी)
Linen or flax, (Linum usitatissimum.)
mn. (-मः-मं)
1 An airy room on the top of a house.
2 An apartment on the top of a hall.
3 The back of an edifice.
4 A fortified place in front of a building.
5 A building of a particular form.
6 Wove silk:
7 Linen cloth.
E.
क्षोम q. v. अण् added.

m. (-कः)
Cor, a species of perfume.

m. (-रः)
1 Shaving the head.
2 Shaving in general.
(-री)
A razor.
E.
क्षुर a razor, affix अण्.

m. (-कः)
A barber.
E.
क्षुर a razor, affix ठक्.
